qs.en: I am looking for the common good for our society.

qs.s: Tu sais ___ se trouve la gare la plus proche ?
qs.en: Do you know where the nearest train station is?

qs.s: ___ as-tu mis mes clés ?
qs.en: Where did you put my keys?

qs.s: Je vais ___ tu vas, sans hésiter.
qs.en: I go where you go, without hesitation.

qs.s: Reste ___ tu es, je viendrai te rejoindre.
qs.en: Stay where you are, I will come to join you.

qs.s: C'est la ville ___ je suis né.
qs.en: It is the city where I was born.

qs.s: Il m'a montré le quartier ___ se trouvait son ancienne école.
qs.en: He showed me the neighbourhood in which his old school used to be.
